prompt:
Setup: the agent is dropped into a copy of test-projects/ledgerd, a small FastAPI service. It reads CLAUDE.md and NOTES.md as a real session would. NOTES.md records three settled decisions (rate limiter state in Redis, 429 + Retry-After, keyed per API key), two open questions (per-tenant quotas, a higher mobile limit), one invariant (balances never older than 30s) and two user quotes ('partners are the noisy neighbors', 'pick a default and we'll revisit'). Nothing in the project mentions an admin panel or auth; the agent has to reason from what is there.

User's message: Should the admin panel use JWT or session cookies?

assertions.text: The first sentence is the answer with a lean
No headers and at most one bold phrase
The reply does not restate the question and has no performative phrases
The reason given ties to something in the project context (the mobile app, partners, admin staff, or existing infra), not generic textbook trade-offs only
